title: Newport Beach Dentistry
description: dentistryofnewportbeach.com Newport Beach Dentistry family dental practice in Newport Beach, CA (1401 Avocado Ave, Ste 209), founded 30+ years ago and currently run by brothers Dr. F. Frank Foroutan (USC DDS 1998) and Dr. F. Ryan Foroutan (USC DDS 1996) — a practice that changed ownership from Dr. Rasch → Kantor/Appelsies → Foroutan over the decades. Services: implants, crowns, veneers, Invisalign, root canals, periodontics, extractions, sedation, whitening, emergency care (same-day); accepts Delta Dental Premier/PPO and most major insurance, CareCredit financing; $99 new-patient special (exam + X-rays + cleaning). Team ~10 (Nancy — office manager, Monica — front desk, Erica — hygienist); languages: English, Farsi, Spanish. Related entities: Foroutan Dental Inc. (Buena Park), OC Elite Dental (Buena Park + Anaheim Hills); also connected to F. Foroutan DDS Inc. (Corona). No revenue disclosed (private practice, est. $2–5M/yr for 3 doctors in this location).
